title: Simplicity (from Walden)
titleZh: 简朴生活（《瓦尔登湖》节选）
author: Henry David Thoreau
intro: 梭罗在瓦尔登湖畔独居两年的思考：把生活压缩到最本真的样子。长句、抽象词与修辞密集，适合已经熟练后挑战阅读节奏与标点。

paragraphs.en: I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately, to front only the essential facts of life, and see if I could not learn what it had to teach, and not, when I came to die, discover that I had not lived.
paragraphs.zh: 我走进森林，是因为我希望从容地生活，只面对生活最本质的事实，看看自己能否学会它要教给我的东西，免得临终时才发现自己从未真正活过。

paragraphs.en: I did not wish to live what was not life, living is so dear; nor did I wish to practise resignation, unless it was quite necessary.
paragraphs.zh: 我不愿过那种并非生活的生活，因为活着的代价如此珍贵；我也不愿去练习逆来顺受，除非实在迫不得已。

paragraphs.en: I wanted to live deep and suck out all the marrow of life, to live so sturdily and Spartan-like as to put to rout all that was not life, to cut a broad swath and shave close, to drive life into a corner, and reduce it to its lowest terms.
paragraphs.zh: 我要深深地活着，吸尽生活的全部精髓；我要活得坚强而简朴，把一切不是生活的东西统统击退，开辟宽路、精简到底，把生活逼到墙角，归结到最简单的形式。

paragraphs.en: Our life is frittered away by detail. Simplify, simplify. Instead of three meals a day, if it be necessary eat but one; instead of a hundred dishes, five; and reduce other things in proportion.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的生活被琐碎细节消耗殆尽。简化，再简化。一天不必吃三餐，如有必要，一餐足矣；不必摆一百道菜，五道即可；其余事情也照此比例削减。

paragraphs.en: Simplicity, simplicity, simplicity! I say, let your affairs be as two or three, and not a hundred or a thousand; instead of a million count half a dozen, and keep your accounts on your thumb-nail.
paragraphs.zh: 简朴，简朴，还是简朴！我说，让你的事务只有两三件，而不是上百上千件；不必去数一百万，只数半打就够了，把账目写在拇指甲上。

paragraphs.en: In the midst of this chopping sea of civilized life, such are the clouds and storms and quicksands and thousand-and-one items to be allowed for, that a man has to live, if he would not founder and go to the bottom and not make his port at all, by dead reckoning, and he must be a great calculator indeed who succeeds.
paragraphs.zh: 在这片文明生活的波涛汹涌之海中，有云雾、有风暴、有流沙，还有千千万万要应付的琐事；一个人若不想触礁沉底、根本进不了港，就只能靠推算航位来生活，而能成功的人，必定是个了不起的计算家。

paragraphs.en: Simplify the problem of life, distinguish the necessary and the real. Probe the earth to see where your main roots run.
paragraphs.zh: 把生活这道题简化，分清什么是必需的、什么是真实存在的。往土里探寻，看清楚你主要的根扎向何处。
